children.name: Capraiellus panzeri
children.description: Capraiellus panzeri is a species of non-cosmopolitan cockroach in the subfamily Ectobiinae: commonly known by its original (genus) name Ectobius panzeri.

children.name: Ectobius lapponicus
children.description: Ectobius lapponicus, also known as the dusky cockroach,is a species of cockroach found in Europe, northern Asia (excluding China), the northeastern United States, and southeastern Canada.

children.name: Ectobius pallidus
children.description: Ectobius pallidus, the tawny cockroach, is a species of non-cosmopolitan cockroach in the family Ectobiidae.

children.name: Ectobius sylvestris
children.description: Ectobius sylvestris, known generally as the forest cockroach or lesser cockroach, is a species of cockroach in the family Ectobiidae.

children.name: Paratropes bilunata
children.description: Paratropes bilunata is a species of cockroach within the family Ectobiidae, that can be found in Costa Rica and Panama.

children.name: Paratropes mexicana
children.description: Paratropes mexicana is a species of cockroach within the family Ectobiidae that is distributed in Mexico.
